dict.string: MacSweep asks System Events for your login items so you can remove them. It asks Finder to move items to the Trash that macOS only lets Finder move, and to empty the Trash when you tell it to.
MacSweep looks for large, duplicate and leftover files on your Desktop.
MacSweep looks for large, duplicate and leftover files and project build folders in Documents.
MacSweep looks for old downloads and installers you no longer need.
MacSweep searches network folders only if you add them in Settings.
MacSweep looks for items in the Trash on removable drives and in folders you add in Settings.
